I'm Ariq Abrar Sofyan — an undergraduate Chemical Engineering student at Universitas Gadjah Mada, interested in renewable energy, energy conversion, industrial processes, and sustainable technological development.

Beyond academics, I have been involved in student organizations and event committees, including inter-school and inter-university activities. I value collaboration, communication, and continuous learning as ways to turn ideas into meaningful contributions.

My current interests include hydrogen technology, biofuels, chemical process engineering, and industrial energy efficiency.
